business_summary: AltPlus Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, development, and operation of online games for smartphone applications. The company also provides support services to social game business companies, including license provision and business asset support. Additionally, it offers technology and human resources support services to game companies. The company also engages in the design, development, manufacturing, sales, maintenance, licensing, and import and export of software and peripheral equipment, along with content development and distribution services. AltPlus Holdings Inc. was formerly known as AltPlus Inc. and changed its name to AltPlus Holdings Inc. in October 2026. AltPlus Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Toshima, Japan.
